title: Fuel Tank Capacity — 3.7L Duratec
introduction:
I check the engine label before reading across to the capacity. Engines grouped on the same row share the listed specification; the blank general row has no separate capacity value. Keep the gallon and litre units attached to their figures.

Think of capacity as the tank’s size label. It tells you how much the tank holds, but cannot tell you whether fuel is reaching the engine correctly. This page is a capacity lookup, with no fuel-delivery test or tank-service procedure.

edits.why: Choose the populated row matching the engine, then read its capacity and units together. A tank-capacity figure does not establish fuel pressure, pump performance or the quantity currently aboard.

editorialRevision.scope: Only inherited power parenthetical removed from title; actual 3.7L Duratec identity and all other public fields unchanged.
